item.title: Why Can’t the UN Say ‘Yahav Lichner’?
item.description: When asked recently about serious allegations that Yahav Lichner, a high-level United Nations staff member working for Unicef, had leaked sensitive, confidential information years ago to Israeli diplomats, the UN and relevant agencies avoided naming him in their public stated responses. item.title: Who do you want to be the next UN Secretary-General?
item.description: Make your choice --- Who do you want to be the next UN Secretary-General? --- PassBlue presents our readers with a very informal poll of the seven Secretary-General candidates as of Aug. 9, 2026. Although the public has no say in who the UN Security Council picks for final approval by the UN General Assembly this year, the UN chief represents the world body of “we the peoples.”
